article_manifest.title: Chadian drone strike in the Agadez region: Chadian ambassador to Niger summoned to the office of the Minister of Foreign Affairs
article_manifest.original_title: Frappe de drones tchadiens dans la région d’Agadez : L’ambassadeur tchadien au Niger convoqué au cabinet du Ministre des affaires étrangères
article_manifest.summary: Niamey, Oct 27 (ANP)- The Minister of Justice, Keeper of the Seals, Mr. Alio Daouda, acting Minister of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and Nigeriens Abroad, received this Tuesday, October 27, 2026, the Ambassador of the Republic of Chad in Niger, after the drone strike of his country occurred in the region of Agadez (Niger) This measure follows a drone airstrike that occurred on October 24, 2026, around 1 a.m., in the Emiloulou area, Agadez region.

article_manifest.title: Chad rejects Niger's accusations after drone strike
article_manifest.original_title: Le Tchad rejette les accusations du Niger après une frappe de drone
article_manifest.summary: Chad rejects Niger's accusations after a drone strike Niger accuses its neighbour of having carried out "a drone airstrike carried out from the territory of Chad" and in which, according to him, France participated. The incident reportedly took place on October 24 at 1 a.m. east of Emi Lulu, not far from the Algerian and Libyan borders .

article_manifest.title: Mali: Four pro-democracy activists brought to justice after almost six months in detention
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: quatre militants pro-démocratie présentés à la justice après presque six mois de détention
article_manifest.summary: Mali: Four pro-democracy activists brought to justice after almost six months of detention In Mali, four pro-democracy activists detained by the state security for nearly six months in unknown locations and outside any judicial framework reappeared on Tuesday, October 20. They were presented to the specialized judicial center against cybercrime and are now imprisoned in the Bamako prison .

article_manifest.title: Chad-Niger: N’Djamena rejects accusations of drone strikes in Agadez
article_manifest.original_title: Tchad-Niger : N’Djamena rejette les accusations de frappe de drone à Agadez
article_manifest.summary: The Chadian government firmly rejects the accusations of Niger, which attributes to him a drone strike that occurred on October 24, 2026, at around 1 a.m., in the Emiloulou area, in the Agadez region. In a statement, N’Djamena denies having ordered, conducted or supported an air military operation against Nigerian territory The Chadian authorities also deny any assistance given to a foreign power to carry out hostile action against Niger.

article_manifest.title: NOTICE OF EXPRESSION OF INTEREST NO.004/CA/TAFOUK TV/2026
article_manifest.original_title: AVIS À MANIFESTATION D’INTÉRÊT N°004/CA/TAFOUK TV/2026
article_manifest.summary: RECRUITMENT OF A FIRM FOR the DEVELOPMENT OF TAFOUK TV 'S ADMINISTRATIVE, ACCOUNTING and FINANCIAL PROCEDURES MANUAL. 1. Context and justification Created by decision of the Heads of State of the Confederation of Sahel States, TAFOUK TV is an initiative that takes place in a regional context marked by many challenges facing the member countries of the Alliance of Sahel States (AES), in particular insecurity related to terrorism, geopolitical tensions, economic and social difficulties, as well as informational and media warfare, characterized by often biased narratives about the Sahel.

article_manifest.title: NOTICE OF EXPRESSION OF INTEREST NO.001/CA/TAFOUK TV/2026
article_manifest.original_title: AVIS DE MANIFESTATION D’INTÉRÊT N°001/CA/TAFOUK TV/2026
article_manifest.summary: RECRUTEMENT D’UN CABINET SPÉCIALISÉ POUR L’ÉLABORATION DU MANUEL TECHNIQUE D’UTILISATION ET DE MAINTENANCE DES ÉQUIPEMENTS DE TAFOUK TV 1. CONTEXTE TAFOUK TV est la chaîne de télévision de l’Alliance des États du Sahel (AES), créée pour contribuer à la promotion de l’intégration sous-régionale, à la diffusion de l’information institutionnelle, à la valorisation des cultures des pays membres et au renforcement de la souveraineté informationnelle de l’espace AES.

article_manifest.title: Niger denounces a drone attack by Chad with "the support of France"
article_manifest.original_title: Le Niger dénonce une attaque de drone du Tchad avec «l’appui de la France»
article_manifest.summary: The facts date back to October 24 at 1am in the Emi Lulu area, in the Agadez region, not far from the Algerian border. This drone strike was carried out "from Chad" with "the support of France", according to the Nigerien government and left two civilians dead and wounded . Niamey speaks of an act of aggression, a violation of his national sovereignty and announces referral to the United Nations Security Council, the Peace and Security Council of the African Union invoking the UN Charter and the founding principles of the AU.

article_manifest.title: Drone strike in Agadez: Chad's ambassador summoned to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
article_manifest.original_title: Frappe de drone à Agadez : l’ambassadeur du Tchad convoqué au ministère des Affaires étrangères
article_manifest.summary: The Minister of Justice, Keeper of the Seals, Mr. Alio Daouda, acting Minister of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and Nigeriens Abroad, H.E. Bakary Yaou Sangaré, received on Tuesday, October 27, 2026 the Ambassador of the Republic of Chad in Niger, as part of the summons relating to the drone strike in the Agadez region This measure follows a drone airstrike that occurred on October 24, 2026, around 1 a.m., in the Emiloulou area, Agadez region.

article_manifest.title: Chadian drone strikes in Niger: CODDAE calls for increased vigilance at national level
article_manifest.original_title: Frappes de drones tchadiens au Niger : le CODDAE appelle au renforcement de la vigilance au plan national
article_manifest.summary: Niamey, Oct 27 (ANP)- The Collective for the Defense of the Right to Energy CODDAE issued a press release on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, denouncing the aggression of the drone from Chad during the night of October 24 to 25 that hit the Emi Lulu area. This attack, the statement reports, “clearly seeks to open a new front against Niger and the Alliance of Sahel States (AES), which strengthens our sacred union” To this end, the Collective calls on the Nigerien population to strengthen national vigilance in the face of this attempt to sow terror.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: 12 Beninese arrested in an alleged fraud case
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : 12 Béninois interpellés dans une affaire d’escroquerie présumée
article_manifest.summary: Douze ressortissants béninois sont interpellés à Gaoua, dans le sud-ouest du Burkina Faso. Ils sont soupçonnés d’avoir monté deux réseaux d’arnaque qui profitaient de la crédulité de personnes en quête de protection selon l’Agence d’Information du Burkina Faso. Les interpellations ont eu lieu les 21 et 22 octobre 2026, a annoncé mardi le chef du Service régional de la police judiciaire (SRPJ) du Djôrô, le capitaine Théophile Zongo.

article_manifest.title: Image Africa Niger: Chad denies any involvement in "drone strikes" on its soil with the "support" of France
article_manifest.original_title: Image Afrique Niger: le Tchad dément toute implication dans "frappe de drone" sur son sol avec "l'appui" de la France
article_manifest.summary: On Tuesday, October 27, Chad rejected accusations from Niger, a neighboring country with which relations have been tense for several months. The latter accuses him of having killed two civilians in a "drone strike" on Nigerien soil with the "support" of France. Through its spokesperson, Gassim Chérif Mahamat, N’Djamena categorically denied Niamey's accusations about a drone strike on Nigerian soil on Monday, October 26 .

article_manifest.title: Mali: A convoy of 1107 tankers filled with fuel arrives in Bamako
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Un convoi de 1107 camions-citernes remplis de carburant débarque à Bamako
article_manifest.summary: Mali: A convoy of 1107 fuel-filled tankers arrives in Bamako In Mali, the state continues to ensure fuel supply in the capital Bamako and the rest of the country. On the morning of yesterday, Monday, October 26, 2026, an impressive convoy of 1,107 tanker trucks filled with fuel arrived in the city of the three caimans ,under military escort . This is the largest convoy that Bamako has hosted since the beginning of this month of October, according to the Directorate General of Trade, Consumer Affairs and Competition.

article_manifest.title: Why relations are deteriorating between Niger and Chad
article_manifest.original_title: Pourquoi les relations se détériorent entre le Niger et le Tchad
article_manifest.summary: The Nigerien government once again accuses Chad and France of having carried out hostile action on its territory. According to Niamey, a drone strike in the Agadez region, near the Algerian border, killed two civilians and injured several others. The Nigerien authorities claim that the operation was carried out from Chadian territory with the support of France .

article_manifest.title: A new rift in the coast.. A crisis between Niamey and N'Djamena in which the threads of Paris are intertwined
article_manifest.original_title: شرخ جديد في الساحل.. أزمة بين نيامي ونجامينا تتشابك فيها خيوط باريس
article_manifest.summary: In a new escalation that has restored tension and congestion to the Sahel region of Africa, Niger on Monday evening filed a complaint before the United Nations against Chad, summoning N'Djamena's ambassador to it, after accusing its neighbor of launching a drone strike on its territory, which left deaths and injuries as well as material damage. . The escalation not only accused N'Djamena of violating sovereignty and supporting those she described as “mercenaries,” but also took on a deeper regional character, with Niger pointing the finger directly at Paris and its attempts to reposition its lost influence.

article_manifest.title: Macina: humanitarian emergency intensifies for 542 displaced people from Souleye
article_manifest.original_title: Macina : l’urgence humanitaire s’accentue pour 542 déplacés de Souleye
article_manifest.summary: Fleeing the attack on their village on September 3, 542 residents of Souleye, in the Ségou region, found refuge in Macina. Saturated houses, lack of food and difficulties in accessing school and social services: there are many needs. Despite the solidarity of local populations and the support of humanitarians, reception conditions remain difficult Forced to flee in a hurry, Souleye residents abandoned their homes, property and livelihoods.

article_manifest.title: Analysis. Chad-Niger tensions: how the Sahel is becoming a proxy conflict terrain Sahel Horizon
article_manifest.original_title: Analyse. Tensions Tchad-Niger : comment le Sahel devient un terrain de conflits par procuration Sahel Horizon
article_manifest.summary: The accusation made by the Nigerien authorities against Chad, after a deadly drone strike on 24 October 2026 in Nigerien territory [in the Emi Lulu area, in the Agadez region, near the Algerian border], marks a new stage in the crisis between the two countries. Niamey reports two civilians killed and several injured . The government announces that it wants to refer the matter to the UN Security Council and the African Union.

article_manifest.title: Niger Strike: Chad Denies Involvement and Demands Evidence
article_manifest.original_title: Frappe au Niger: le Tchad nie être impliqué et réclame des preuves
article_manifest.summary: Relations between Chad and Niger escalated on 26 October. Niamey accused his neighbor of carrying out a drone strike in the Agadez region with the complicity of France. The reaction of the Chadian government was not long in coming Indeed, on Tuesday, October 27, N 'djamena denied any involvement in this operation and asked the Nigerien authorities to present the elements on which their accusations are based.

article_manifest.title: Drone strike on Agadez: Chad reacts to Niger's accusations
article_manifest.original_title: Frappe de drone sur Agadez : Le Tchad réagit aux accusations du Niger
article_manifest.summary: Chad does not admit to conducting a drone strike on Emi loulou (hill in the Agadez region) on Saturday, October 24. He firmly rejected these accusations of Niamey, in a statement read this Tuesday, October 27 by his Minister of Communication, Gassim Chérif Mahamat, on national television . The Nigerien authorities invited to make public the evidence they say N’Djaména is holding assures that he has "in no way ordered, conducted or supported any air military operation from his soil against Niger" .

article_manifest.title: The Interregional Service of the Judicial Police dismantles three criminal gangs
article_manifest.original_title: Le Service inter-régional de la Police judiciaire démantèle trois bandes de malfaiteurs
article_manifest.summary: Zinder, Oct 26 (ANP)- The Zinder Judicial Police has dismantled three networks of young criminals specializing in night robberies, in the city and its surroundings. The thugs were presented Tuesday, October 26 to the media with a large amount of stolen objects . The three specialized gangs that operate in the riverside neighborhoods benefit from the complicity of a concealer woman who was arrested just as she was about to leave Zinder for a neighboring country.

article_manifest.title: Tchad-Niger : une nouvelle escalade entre Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno et Abdourahamane Tiani
article_manifest.original_title: Tchad-Niger : une nouvelle escalade entre Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno et Abdourahamane Tiani
article_manifest.summary: Niamey accuse N’Djamena d’avoir lancé une frappe de drone sur son territoire, avec le soutien de la France. Une charge qui ravive la méfiance entre les deux voisins. Publié aujourd'hui à 16h57, modifié à 20h39 Lecture : 5 minutes.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Niamey accuses Chad and France after a drone strike
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : Niamey accuse le Tchad et la France après une frappe de drone
article_manifest.summary: The Nigerien territory was targeted, on October 24, 2026 at around 1 a.m., by a drone strike carried out from Chadian territory with the "support" of France, informs a statement from the government of Niamey read on public television. According to the announcement, made on October 26, 2026, the attack left two civilians dead, several wounded . The drone strike also damaged vehicles in the Agadez region, near the Algerian border.

article_manifest.title: Agadez: The governor chairs the regular meeting of the CRS and visits the wounded from the attack on two SONITRAV buses
article_manifest.original_title: Agadez : Le gouverneur préside la réunion ordinaire du CRS et rend visite aux blessés de l’attaque contre deux bus SONITRAV
article_manifest.summary: The Governor of the Agadez region, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired, on October 21, 2026, the regular meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS) devoted to the review of the security situation in the region and the events following the attack perpetrated on Tuesday, October 20, 2026 by armed bandits against two SONITRAV buses, on the Tchirozérine-Agadez axis At the end of this meeting, the governor, accompanied by the members of the CRS, went to the Regional Hospital Center (CHR) of Agadez to inquire about the state of health of the wounded and to show the compassion of the country's authorities to…

article_manifest.title: Working visit of the Minister of State, Minister of National Defence to Algeria: Niamey and Algiers strengthen their security cooperation for the protection of their common interests
article_manifest.original_title: Visite de travail du Ministre d’Etat, ministre de la Défense Nationale en Algérie : Niamey et Alger renforcent leur coopération sécuritaire pour la protection de leurs intérêts communs
article_manifest.summary: Depuis, la visite du Général d’Armée Abdourahamane Tiani à Alger en février 2026, l’Algérie et le Niger renforcent leur coopération, notamment dans le domaine de la Défense et de la Sécurité, lui donnant ainsi une dimension stratégique. C’est dans le cadre de cette nouvelle dynamique que le Ministre d’État, Ministre de la Défense Nationale, le Général d’Armée Salifou Mody a effectué une visite de travail à Alger, le mardi 20 octobre 2026, accompagné d’une délégation d’experts du Ministère de la Défense Nationale.

article_manifest.title: Official statement of the government following a drone strike in Nigerian territory by Chad
article_manifest.original_title: Communiqué officiel du gouvernement suite à une frappe par drone en territoire nigérien par le Tchad
article_manifest.summary: The Government informs national and international opinion that on October 24, 2026, at around 1 a.m., the national territory was the target of a drone airstrike carried out from the territory of Chad in the Emiloulou area, Agadez region, with the support of a foreign power, France. This strike resulted in the death of two civilians and injuries. It also damaged vehicles .

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: 12 suspected crooks arrested in Gaoua
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina: 12 présumés escrocs interpellés à Gaoua
article_manifest.summary: Twelve suspected fraudsters of Beninese nationality were arrested on 21 and 22 October 2026 in Gaoua in south-west Burkina Faso by the Regional Judicial Police Service (SRPJ) of Djôrô, reports the AIB, on Tuesday 27 October.

article_manifest.title: Hostile act: N’Djamena rejects Niamey's accusations and demands evidence
article_manifest.original_title: Acte hostile : N’Djamena rejette les accusations de Niamey et exige des preuves
article_manifest.summary: The Chadian government firmly rejected, on Tuesday, October 27, Niger's accusations attributing to it a deadly drone strike that occurred on October 24 in the Agadez region, which the Nigerien authorities described, the day before, as a "hostile act" In a statement read on national television, government spokesman Gassim Chérif Mahamat demanded evidence from Niamey and announced that N’Djamena was in favour of an independent international investigation.

article_manifest.title: Accusations of strikes in Niger: Chad denies and demands proof of Niamey
article_manifest.original_title: Accusations de frappes au Niger : le Tchad dément et exige des preuves de Niamey
article_manifest.summary: The tone rises between N’Djamena and Niamey. The Chadian government on Tuesday rejected accusations by the Nigerien authorities that a drone strike carried out from Chadian territory targeted an area of the Agadez region on the night of 24 October, causing the death of two civilians and injuring several others, according to the toll announced by Niamey In a statement read on national television, the Minister of Communication and government spokesman, Gassim Chérif Mahamat, assured that Chad had "in no way ordered, conducted or supported" an air military operation against Niger.

article_manifest.title: Territorial aggression in Niger: Niamey accuses Chad and France after a drone strike and seizes the UN
article_manifest.original_title: Agression territoriale au Niger : Niamey accuse le Tchad et la France après une frappe de drone et saisit l’ONU
article_manifest.summary: In an official statement issued on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, the Government of the Republic of Niger denounced an airstrike that targeted its national territory on the night of October 24. Balance sheet, two civilians killed and several wounded. Directly accusing Chad and France, the Nigerien authorities announced a battery of diplomatic, judicial and security responses .

article_manifest.title: Justice. In Burkina Faso, a new Penal Code reinstates the death penalty International mail
article_manifest.original_title: Justice. Au Burkina Faso, un nouveau Code pénal rétablit la peine de mort Courrier international
article_manifest.summary: Abolished in 2018, then mentioned again in December 2025, the death penalty was reinstated in the new version of the Burkinabe Criminal Code adopted by the deputies on October 20. It must now be promulgated by the President, Ibrahim Traoré. The death penalty “is provided in particular for acts of terrorism, treason, espionage, assassination, parricide and certain other serious crimes,” details Studio Yafa The text provides for the execution of this sentence, "shooting, lethal injection, hanging or electrocution", adds the media of the Swallow Foundation.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Niamey blames Chad and France after deadly drone strike
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : Niamey accuse le Tchad et la France après une frappe de drone meurtrière
article_manifest.summary: Niger: Niamey accuses Chad and France after a deadly drone strike The Nigerien government claims that its territory was targeted, Saturday around 00:00 GMT, by an airstrike carried out by drone from Chad, with the alleged support of France. The attack reportedly took place in the Emi Lulu area, in the Agadez region, near the Algerian border According to the Niamey authorities, the strike left two civilians dead, several injured and damaged vehicles.

article_manifest.title: Tahoua: Minister Abdourahamane Oumarou hosts a public conference on Refoundation and the Change of Mindsets in Niger
article_manifest.original_title: Tahoua : Le Ministre Abdourahamane Oumarou anime une conférence publique sur la Refondation et le Changement des mentalités au Niger
article_manifest.summary: Tahoua, October 27, 2026 (ANP)- The Minister of Refoundation and Promotion of Social Values, Mr. Abdourahamane Oumarou, hosted, on Monday, October 26, 2026, at the Djibo Hamani University in Tahoua, a public conference on the theme "Refoundation and Change of Mindsets in Niger: What values to build a patriotic, responsible and committed youth?" .

article_manifest.title: Tafouk TV, the new media arm of Moscow-backed Sahelian juntas
article_manifest.original_title: Tafouk TV, the new media arm of Moscow-backed Sahelian juntas
article_manifest.summary: Launched by the military regimes of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, Tafouk TV aims to impose the Alliance of Sahel States’ sovereignty-focused narrative. Encouraged by Russia, the broadcaster is emerging as repression against local journalists intensifies.

article_manifest.title: النيجر تتعهد بالردّ على تشاد بعد قصف بطائرة مسيّرة
article_manifest.original_title: النيجر تتعهد بالردّ على تشاد بعد قصف بطائرة مسيّرة
article_manifest.summary: - النيجر تدين الهجوم باعتباره انتهاكًا للسيادة الوطنية، وتتهم تشاد بتوفير دعم استراتيجي للمرتزقة الذين يهاجمون السكان والبنية التحتية، مشيرة إلى دعم قوى أجنبية. - الحكومة النيجرية تؤكد حقها في الدفاع عن أراضيها وسكانها، وتنفي دعمها لقوات المعارضة التشادية، وسط تبادل الاتهامات بين البلدين بدعم قوات متمردة. تعهدت النيجر بالردّ بعد قصف طائرة مسيّرة تشادية لمنطقة إيمي لولو في إقليم أغاديز شرقي البلاد، بزعم وجود قوات من المعارضة التشادية فيها، في خطوة تدفع بتوتر جديد للعلاقات بين البلدين.

article_manifest.title: Image Africa Algerian soldiers deployed in Niger: the French history of the Madama military base
article_manifest.original_title: Image Afrique Soldats algériens déployés au Niger: l'histoire française de la base militaire de Madama
article_manifest.summary: Algerian soldiers are due to reach the Madama base in northern Niger, "Jeune Afrique" reported on Sunday. This place near Libya had been set up by the French army from 2014 to monitor the roads of armed groups, before being put to sleep in 2023. Madama military base in Niger Madama is about to wake up from its sleep with a new military partner According to information reported by our colleagues from Jeune Afrique, Algerian units are to be deployed in this base located a hundred kilometers from the Libyan border, at the request of the Nigerien authorities.

article_manifest.title: Niger: The country denounces a drone attack by Chad with "the support of France"
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: Le pays dénonce une attaque de drone du Tchad avec «l'appui de la France»
article_manifest.summary: Niger summons Chad's ambassador following a drone strike on its territory. In a statement read on national television on Monday, October 26, the Nigerien government denounced "a drone airstrike carried out from the territory of Chad" and in which, according to it, France participated. The incident comes as relations continue to deteriorate between Niamey and Ndjamena The facts date back to 24 October at 1am in the Emi Lulu area, in the Agadez region, not far from the Algerian border.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Thirteen civilians killed by an army drone strike, in the Timbuktu region
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Treize civils tués par une frappe de drone de l'armée, dans la région de Tombouctou
article_manifest.summary: In Mali, thirteen civilians, including six children, were killed on the night of Sunday to Monday, October 26, by a drone strike by the Malian army, near Lerneb, in the Timbuktu region, according to information verified by RFI from many local sources. The General Staff did not communicate about this strike . The Malian army, together with its Russian partners in the Africa Corps, is fighting jihadist or pro-independence groups active in the country.

article_manifest.title: Ukraine Allegedly Supporting Mali Militia
article_manifest.original_title: Ukraine Allegedly Supporting Mali Militia
article_manifest.summary: Ukraine is facing questions over its alleged involvement in supporting Tuareg fighters in northern Mali, a development that could extend its rivalry with Russia into Africa's Sahel region. A September 2026 CNN investigation reported that around 15 Ukrainian drone specialists were assisting Tuareg fighters, although DW said it had not independently verified the claims and Ukraine has not confirmed a specific operation.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Niamey accuses Chad of a drone strike that killed two people
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : Niamey accuse le Tchad d’une frappe de drone ayant fait deux morts
article_manifest.summary: The Nigerien government accuses Chad of having carried out a drone strike against the Emiloulou area, in the Agadez region, on October 24, 2026, around 1 a.m. According to a statement broadcast on national television, the attack left two civilians dead, several wounded and damaged vehicles . Niamey claims that the drone left Chadian territory with the support of France.

article_manifest.title: Niger: two civilians killed in drone strike, Niamey accuses Chad and France
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : deux civils tués dans une frappe de drone, Niamey accuse le Tchad et la France
article_manifest.summary: The Nigerien government accused Chad and France of being involved in a drone airstrike that left two civilians dead and several injured on October 24 in the Emi Lulu area, in the Agadez region, announcing a series of diplomatic measures and the referral to international bodies According to a government statement, the strike occurred around 1:00 am and was allegedly carried out from Chadian territory "with the support of a foreign power, France".

article_manifest.summary: King Mohammed VI on Monday, October 26, expressed his strong condemnation of the abject terrorist attack last Friday on a church in Al-Karak Governorate, Jordan.

article_manifest.title: Bamako: when violent death and disappearances become a worrying reality
article_manifest.original_title: Bamako : quand la mort violente et les disparitions deviennent une inquiétante réalité
article_manifest.summary: On the banks of the Djoliba, October ends in pain: a woman who was allegedly killed by her husband only a week after their marriage, a young shopkeeper found slaughtered in his shop in Commune I, young people invited to nocturnal meetings then found dead in the ACI sector or near the market Les Halles de Bamako In addition to these tragedies, disappearances have become too frequent in the city of the Three Caymans.

article_manifest.title: Niger accuses Chad of deadly drone attack in which two civilians died
article_manifest.original_title: Niger accuses Chad of deadly drone attack in which two civilians died
article_manifest.summary: As their relations continue to deteriorate, Niger’s military government on Monday accused Chad of carrying out a deadly drone strike in which two civilians were killed and others wounded. In a statement by the authorities read on national television, it said it had summoned the Chadian ambassador following the incident. Niamey also demanded an immediate end to "hostile actions" and compensation for the damage caused.

article_manifest.title: Chadian drone strikes on Nigerian territory: Niamey condemns this action and announces diplomatic and security measures
article_manifest.original_title: Frappes de drones tchadiens sur le territoire nigérien : Niamey condamne cette action et annonce des mesures diplomatiques et sécuritaires
article_manifest.summary: Niamey, Oct 26 (ANP) – The Nigerien government has condemned in the strongest terms an airstrike carried out by drone, on October 24, 2026, around one o'clock in the morning, in the Emi Loulou area, Agadez region, which it attributes to the Chadian state with the support of France. According to the Nigerien authorities, this strike caused the death of two civilians, injured people and damaged vehicles In a statement, the government says that this attack targeted the national territory and deplores the loss of life as well as the material damage recorded.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Why Ukraine May Be Involved in Mali's Conflict
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Why Ukraine May Be Involved in Mali's Conflict
article_manifest.summary: Allegations that Ukrainian specialists are supporting Tuareg rebels in Mali highlight Kyiv's effort to challenge Russian influence far beyond the battlefield in Europe. Ukraine is fighting Russia — and the conflict may extend into Africa's Sahel region. According to an investigation published by US media outlet CNN in September, around 15 Ukrainian drone specialists are reportedly supporting Tuareg rebels in northern Mali.

article_manifest.title: Cybercrime: “Paying a ransom funds the next attack and guarantees nothing”, Dr Karim Ganamé, Cybersecurity Specialist
article_manifest.original_title: Cybercriminalité : « Payer une rançon finance la prochaine attaque et ne garantit rien », Dr Karim Ganamé, spécialiste de la cybersécurité
article_manifest.summary: Cybercrime: “Paying a ransom funds the next attack and guarantees nothing”, Dr. Karim Ganamé, Cybersecurity Specialist Ransomware attacks are a growing threat to businesses, governments and critical infrastructure Behind these cyberattacks sometimes lurk real criminal organizations, structured like businesses, who take their victims' data hostage and demand ransoms of up to several million dollars.
